portraitReview.identityBasis: The opened Commons source caption explicitly names the subject; author and license were checked against that page and cached metadata. Identity rests on source context, not facial recognition.
portraitReview.visualReview: Viewed the actual local image in a labeled contact sheet (and any replacement separately); confirmed a usable color photograph. Original image bytes retained without recoloring.

editorialNotes: Chinese original prose and full English translation received AI editorial review; remaining locale review is handled separately.
Selected substantive milestones include early life, public achievements and material controversies; this is not an exhaustive news archive.
The four-star influence object is copied exactly from contemporary-1000; influence is not a moral endorsement.
AI editorial review is not human or native-language certification.
GOV.UK explicitly dates the premiership to 5 July 2024–20 July 2026. Older university and party biographies are used only for stable education and career facts.

The disputed cropped 2024 Downing Street portrait was rejected after live Commons review. The replacement is Chris McAndrew’s 2017 parliamentary photograph under CC BY 3.0, downloaded and visually reviewed separately.
sourceReviewMethod: Live web searches and selected opened official/institutional and independent sources, cross-checked with cached research. Some official pages were accessible only in search excerpts; no unreviewed Wikidata draft was automatically promoted.

additionalLanguageReview.method: Each full target reviewed field by field by AI against the Chinese/English dossier; the program only validates keys, versions and recorded declarations.
additionalLanguageReview.limitations: AI review, not human or native-speaker certification. Hashes establish correspondence to reviewed files, not independent truth.
